==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I was in a superhero history class. My next class was extremely far away. There was no way for me to get there on time. I was talking with students about my situation. I then noticed that one of the students was the ghost of my late friend Braxton. This gave me lucidity.

I teleported to my next class. There I studied alongside a team of super scientists. It was an honor to work with them.
